newsitem.title: USA: Ault sells shares to underwriters.
newsitem.headline: Ault sells shares to underwriters.

text.p: Ault Inc said it sold an additional 240,000 shares of its stock to an underwriting syndicate headed by Principal Financial Securities and Cruttenden Roth Inc, which exercised an overallotment option related to Ault's December 13 public offering.

Together with proceeds received from the original 1.6 million common shares sold to the public, Ault has received total net proceeds of $10.8 million and will increase its outstanding shares to about 3,986,000 from 2,146,000.
Ault manufactures external power conversion products.
